tagline.en: Scalable, high-performance Android apps for 100M+ users — built and led with clean architecture, CI/CD and AI-accelerated engineering.

about.source: Video transcript (Dec 2024) + LinkedIn summary. Wording is the owner's; ASR errors corrected, pending owner confirmation.
en: I'm an experienced Senior Android developer with over 10 years in the field. I specialize in building scalable, high-performance mobile applications with Kotlin, Java, Jetpack Compose and multi-module architectures.

I have a strong background in integrating third-party SDKs, implementing server-driven UI, and keeping code quality high with test-driven development. I've led Android teams, and today I build weather apps serving 100M+ users at The Weather Company.

My work spans cross-functional teams delivering for businesses across the United States, Saudi Arabia and Singapore. Whether it's building an app from scratch or improving an existing one, I make sure every detail meets both technical and user needs.
